prompt: Rewrite this invitation to sound informal but considerate: 'Attendance is requested at a modest gathering to commemorate completion of the garden shed. Refreshments will be provided. Guests may arrive after four and should not consider bringing a gift obligatory.' Use approximately 120 words for the response.
text: Come celebrate with us as we mark the completion of our garden shed! We’re keeping things simple and relaxed, with some refreshments to enjoy and plenty of time to catch up. Feel free to drop by anytime after 4:00 p.m.—stay for a few minutes or hang out as long as you like. Most importantly, please don’t feel any pressure to bring a gift. Your company is more than enough, and we’d be delighted to see you. We hope you can join us for this small but satisfying milestone and help us enjoy the finished project. Let us know if you think you’ll be able to make it, though no formal RSVP is necessary.
